fields:
Try not to leash your jungler. Very hard lane, you need to kill pre6, pop his boneplate, bait out his Q and then all in him with 4 ferocity. Count his spell cooldowns. Use your jungler, Aatrox has no escape. If you aren't at least 800g ahead at level 6, you will lose fights. Make sure to get executioner's before he hits level 6.
Don't fight mid-late game 1v1 if you aren't ahead AND don't have bruiser build. Your splitpush is better than his. Teamfights depend on how strong the Aatrox is.

Ignite+Flash
Ignite+Teleport
In my opinion Ignite is highly valuable on this lane, without it it's almost impossible to win, if the Aatrox plays correctly.

Rune setup 2
Adaptive, adaptive and armor
Other options are too weak, you need long early fights with as much power as you can

Dblade+1pot or Longsword+3pots.
Get grievous wounds early.
Goredrinker, Sunderer and Shieldbow can reliably 1v1 him mid game if you are ahead, other builds are pretty weak in 1v1.
I personally would choose Goredrinker

It's better if you don't pull for your jungler in this lane, you lose a lot of lane pressure and lower your chances of winning. Level 1 take Q, stack it on minions. If he wastes his Qs, go and pop his boneplate and run back to bush. Wait for him to waste his Qs again and then all in him with empQ jump into full combo. Make sure to not be too long in a fight, you don't want his Q to come back up. Levels 2-5 try to pop his boneplate with your E or jump when he wastes Q and then repeat the full combo from bush 1 or 2 more times until you kill him. Beg your jungler to come toplane pre6 to kill him. Try to get executioner's on your 1st or 2nd back.
You need to remember and count his early game Q …

1v1 at 3 or more items is very dangerous, unless you are ahead (at least 1 item) and have a bruiser/duelist build (Shieldbow or Sunderer). To 1v1 him you NEED Grievous wounds. Splitpushing into him is hard, especially if he has Stridebreaker, so you want to force plays with your team and start a teamfight to get ahead. Focus enemy carries and let your team deal with Aatrox.

Make sure to not die in the early game, giving up CS is good. Rush bramble vest (executioners if you are ahead). Don't get close to bushes if your Q is on cooldown. If you are ahead, make sure you are under his turret and permanently harass him with your Qs. Getting your junglers help and an early kill will most likely win you the lane.

Dshield is a good starting item, because of her Q poke, but you can start Dblade. Level 1 fight only with full ferocity. Levels 2-5 you are stronger, but you have to use your W perfectly (her Q+AA). Force fights on her, especially with full ferocity. Remember and count her W cooldown, if she uses it, just disengage. Level 6 be careful, her R does a lot of damage. Early hexdrinker can help you live, but you don’t need it (waste of gold usually, Maw is trash). Use your jungler, your R can see her in her W.
Mid-late game don’t 1v1 her, she has great disengage with her W, E and R. You are better splitpusher. In teamfights you can use your R for vision on her and let your team kill her fast.

Teleport + Flash
Ignite + Flash
You can run buth, Ignite gives you more kill pressure, but you don't need it.

Rune setup 2 or 3
Adaptive/AS, adaptive and MR
Rune setup 1 is good for longer fights and allows you to heal during laning phase from her Qs
Rune setup 3 makes early trades much harder for Akali and makes you almost unkillable during laning phase
I myself prefer using Rune setup 1, because Akali is not that strong, you don't need the Grasp to survive the laning phase

Dshield+1pot or Dblade+1pot - if you are confident, you can start Long Sword+3pots, but I wouldn't do that.
Most builds can 1v1 her late game, except tank build.
I personally would choose Goredrinker or Eclipse

Level 1 fight only with full ferocity. Levels 2-5 try to engage on her with your full ferocity (empQ from the bush), and do your trade. If she uses her W shroud. use your empW and go back into bush and stack your ferocity back. Next time you engage her with full ferocity, her W will be on cooldown (20 seconds + 5 before the CD starts). The second trade should be triple Q trade. Keep doing this until level 6. At level 6 it gets a bit more dangerous, try to force Akali to use her R1, then disengage and wait out the R2 (10 seconds). If you have problems with this matchup, you can buy hexdrinker for the early MR and shield, but it's mostly useless, because Maw of Malmortius is a trash item.
Leve…
Mid-late game 1v1 is pointless, she has too much disengage with her tools. You can splitpush better or teamfight. In teamfight you can use your R and stay in it until your team kills Akali in her W.

Rune choice is probably Fleet footwork. Play the game slow from early, poke with your Qs and wait for level 6. Try to rush Seeker's. At level 6 you can be stronger than Rengar, if you aren't too behind, but watch his items (hexdrinker). Remember that when ganked past level 6, his R reveals you in your W.

Fairly hard matchup if Camille is experienced. It's best if you don't leash, make sure you are early on lane. Level 1 try to pop her boneplate, but don't do extended trade (unless she has no shield, no boneplate and you have 3/4 stacks). From level 2 proc her boneplate and bait out her passive by letting her AA you. When both shield and boneplate are off cooldown, force a fight. Care about jumps when she is near wall. Mid-game fights are fairly hard, try not to 1v1 her unless very ahead. Splitpush is better for her, teamfights better for you.

Teleport+Flash
Ignite+Flash
Ignite+Teleport
All 3 options are pretty good, but if Camille goes Ignite+Teleport and you have Teleport+Flash, she can kill you early and win the lane.

Rune setup 2 or 3
Adaptive/AS, adaptive, armor
Rune setup 2 makes mid game trades much easier for you. Even though your laning will suffer, it can be good if you are experienced in this matchup
Rune setup 3 makes your laning phase much stronger and allows you to go for solokills more often
I myself prefer using Rune setup 2, if you manage to play the lane well and dodge her E, you can deal a lot of damage, while having good scaling rune

Dblade+1pot
Goredrinker, Sunderer and Shieldbow builds can 1v1 her
I personally would choose Goredrinker or Eclipse

Level 1 you should not leash. If Camille gets to lane first, she can easily zone you off of XP with her Q. Don't 1v1 her unless you have 4 stacks. Level 2-5 you need to play around her shield and boneplating. If she has Boneplating, make sure to proc it with your E or your AA jump. Try to dodge her outer W. Before you fight her, make sure that her Boneplating is down and that you let her proc her shield on you - one AA only, don't take a full trade. Be careful about jumping on her near walls, she can easily E to the wall and E onto you, stun you in the air and escape. Try to play the lane in the middle, where there are no walls nearby, being near turrets is benefical for Camille. Level 6 be …

Mid-late game fights with Camille are mostly pointless, she has a lot of damage and great mobility. Her splitpush is better than yours, she kinda sucks at teamfighting, so you want to force teamfights as much as you can. Don't let her become a late game monster, try to end games quickly.

Go Grasp with boneplate and Biscuits secondary. Level 1 if Rengar is pulling for his jungler, try stopping him from getting to lane. Level 1 you are stronger with Q, so you can zone him from the XP - walk up to him and don't let him get to the wave. You will lose the gold from the first 3 minions, but he will lose both gold and XP (which hurts him a lot more). Play near walls, if you see him using his empowered Q and jump, quickly E wall and E him and run away. Play the game slow, you can't fight him in the early levels. Level 6 get your jungler to toplane, with your ult it should be easy kill. If you are ahead, make sure you invest into Executioners and play under his turret and perma poke …

Remember Cho'Gaths Q cooldown (7 seconds) and make sure you count the seconds when he uses it. You want to do longer trades with tripleQ. Bait his Q before you engage. If he fights you, his E will naturally push the lane towards you. Try to get your jungler top, Cho'Gath has no escape. Level 6 be careful not to get too low for his R to execute you - if he ults too early, you can doubleW all of the damage.
In mid-late game he gets very tanky and can potentially 1v1 you if you have assassin build. Your splitpush is a lot better and your teamfights are better as well. Be careful when forcing objectives, Cho'Gath can always outsmite your jungler (unless it's Nunu, then it's 50/50).

TP+Flash
Ignite+Flash
Both are very good, ignite gives you more kill pressure, but it's not needed for the 1v1, because you can kill even without it.

Rune setup 2 or 3
Adaptive/AS, adaptive, armor/MR (depends on enemy team comp)
Rune setup 2 allows you to have longer fights and gives you an edge in mid game
Rune setup 3 makes laning better, healthier and better for solo kills
I myself prefer using Rune setup 2, you don't really need the Grasp to kill Cho'Gath, so I would rather be a bit weaker in early game (but still stronger than Cho) and strong in the late game

Dblade+1pot - if you are confident, you can start Long Sword+3pots
Goredrinker, Sunderer and Shieldbow can 1v1 him easily
I personally would choose Goredrinker or Sunderer

Level 1 you can fight when his Q is on cooldown (7 second window). Levels 2-5 you have to force fights, you are better in the early game. TripleQ rotation is very good into Cho'Gath. Wait for him to use his Q to farm minions or bait it out by jumping near him and running into a bush. If you jump onto him when his Q is up, he can Q under himself, W you and run away. Level 6 be careful, his R does a lot of damage. If you fight in the wave, his E will naturally push the lane towards you, which means you can freeze and then kill him with your jungler, Cho'Gath has no escape at all.

Mid-late game he can 1v1 you if he's tanky enough and you have either assassin or tank build. You splitpush much faster and your teamfights are better. Be careful about forcing objectives, his R will always outsmite your jungler.

Grasp is very good in this lane. A fairly hard lane, try to keep your Q for his engage and just run away when he does. Try to not die on lane, your passive will keep you very healthy, if you know how to last hit. Make sure to correctly execute him with your R, otherwise he will double W heal the entire damage. Investnig into Bramble vest is very good, limits Rengar's power by a lot.

Permaban this champion or just dodge it on sight.
If you decide to play it, you need to be aggressive level 1 (with full ferocity), levels 3-5 force fights with tripleQ, you have to kill him pre6. Try to get your jungler to help you. Level 6 very dangerous, don't fight if not ahead.
Mid-late game also hard, he beats you 1v1 (unless very ahead), he has better teamfight if he has summoners, you splitpush better and you can catch his teammates out. Try splitting, once he matches you just run and force a 5v4 (use your R, you are faster than he is and he has no TP, he runs Ghost).

Ignite + Flash
You can't afford to run TP, you need both Flash and Ignite.

Rune setup 2 with sudden impact
Adaptive, adaptive and armor
Same as Aatrox, you need as much early power and long fights as you can, because if you don't get kills pre6, the lane is immidiately lost

Dblade+1pot or Long Sword+3pots
Very hard to reliably 1v1 in the mid-late game, best mythic to go for is either Goredrinker or Eclipse (if you are ahead)

Level 1 take Q, DON'T LEASH, get your stacks on minions, but be careful not to get too close to the Darius. If he starts Q level 1, that's good. If he goes W, that's bad. Once you get to 4 stacks, all in him (preferably once he wastes his spell) with Ignite. Levels 3-5 all in him with a full rotation - you want to do either tripleQ or empQ into doubleW. You HAVE TO kill the Darius at least twice before level 6 (or make him lose a lot of minions). If you can, get your jungler to toplane before level 6. At level 6 you don't want to fight him, unless you have at least 2 kills on him (at least 600-900 gold), and even then, fight only with Ignite. Darius top is extremely dangerous once he has his…

Mid-late game don't try to 1v1 unless you are extremely ahead, he will beat you. You are better at splitpushing, but you can't match him 1v1. Teamfights depend if the Darius has his summoner spells or no. Try to catch his teammates out and force 5v4 plays with your R (you are faster than Darius is AND he has no TP).

Very easy lane for Darius, the biggest counter to Rengar. Level one make sure to take W and contest him at 0-2 stacks. If he jumps on a minion near you or you, just AA, W and ghost him down, he can't fight you. The only way Rengar can win is if he gets to 4 stacks at level 1, has Ignite and all ins you for a kill. All you have to do is make sure that doesn't happen. Don't be afraid to give up CS if you aren't experienced in this matchup, just get to level 6 and then it's an auto win.

Make sure to dodge his cleavers, without them he has no damage at all. Early game force fights with full ferocity, you win 1v1s hard. Level 6 consider buying Executioner's, you will cut down a lot of his healing. You can also end your trades with doubleW and time them at the moment he hits a cleaver on you and uses his E (you will heal around 250 damage).
Mid-late game you win 1v1 (but he can easily escape with R) unless you have assassin build. You are better at splitpush and in teamfights.

Teleport + Flash
Ignite + Flash
You can run both, ignite more kill pressure and it's very helpful at level 6 (you can avoid buying executioners), but you don't need it to win lane.

Rune setup 2 or 3
Adaptive/AS, adaptive, armor/MR (depends on enemy team comp)
Rune setup 2 makes your long trades stronger and a gives you better late game
Rune setup 3 gives you stronger quick trades and better early game and some extra sustain
I myself prefer using Rune setup 2, you don't need the Grasp to kill Mundo and Conqueror gives you a lot in mid game

Dblade+1pot - if you are confident, you can start Long Sword+3pots
Grievous wounds very important
Goredrinker, Shieldbow and Sunderer can 1v1 him
I personally would choose Goredrinker or Sunderer

Level 1 you have to dodge his Q. Engage him once you have full ferocity, do a quck empQ, AA, Q combo and keep hitting him for around 5 seconds. You will tank one cleaver and then get out (4 second cooldown). Don't tank two cleavers, they do a lot of damage. Levels 2-5 you want to do the same thing. Get yourself to 4 ferocity, wait for your cooldowns and jump on him with empQ, E, W (his cleaver), AA, Q, empQ. If you are close to killing him, keep fighting. If he's still fairly healthy, just disengage into a bush, jump on a minion, get yourself your stacks and do the same thing in 20 seconds.
When he is level 6, you want to have Executioner's. You can either disengage when he ults, or just bru…
Mid-late game trying to 1v1 is pointless, he can just keep slowing you with Q and run away with R. You splitpush better and are a better teamfighter, so use that to your advantage.

Grasp lane most likely. If Rengar is able to dodge your cleavers, there isn't much you can do. He outdamages you by a lot, has decent sustain and can run you down. You have no setup for your jungler, so this lane is very problematic for you. Definitely build Bramble vest. I'd suggest trying a different champion into Rengar.

Dshield can be a good starting item if she is playing well around her Q and pokes you in the lane with it. Level 1 be careful, her Q has a similar cooldown to yours, but her vitals make the fight better for her. Make sure to farm your stacks, then fight with 4 stacks. During lane you are stronger if you play around your stacks correctly - don't waste empQ into her W. If you get 800 gold on first recall and buy a Bramble vest, Fiora can't play the lane at all. At level 6 just disengage when she ults you, you can root her (if her W is down) or emp W run away fast.
Mid-late game depends on how fed you are. Unless you are very ahead, she beats you. You have a better teamfight, so try to force th…

Teleport + Flash
Ignite + Flash
You can run both, Ignite gives you more kill pressure, but you don't need it.

Rune setup 1, 2 or 3
Adaptive/AS, adaptive and armor
Rune setup 1 gives you fairly good late game and strong laning phase
Rune setup 2 gives you very strong late game and weaker early game
Rune setup 3 gives you strong early game and weaker late game
I myself prefer using Rune setup 2

Dblade+1pot - if you are confident, you can start Long Sword+3pots
Grievous wounds important - first recalll Bramble extremely strong
Goredrinker, Sunderer and Shieldbow can 1v1 her
I personally would choose Goredrinker or Eclipse

I prefer to play this lane with Grasp, makes the laning much easier and gives you a lot more kill pressure. You can start Dshield, if Fiora pokes you a lot with her Q during the lane. Level 1 don't fight unless you have full ferocity. Don't be too late to lane, because she can zone you out of XP. Levels 2-5 you want to keep jumping without using ferocity, once she does AA,Q,E you can empW, quickly run into a bush, jump Q E W Q. Be careful not to empQ into her W - you can use your empQ, let her use her W, cancel your AA and then hit her. Don't get hit by her W - if you do, disengage immidiately. Level 6 when she ults you, just run away and don't let her get the procs. Buying Bramble vest on f…

Late game 1v1 is a very bad idea, Fiora is a perfect late game duelist, you are not. Splitpushing is good for both of you, however in teamfights you are better. Try to force those or get picks with your R.

Medium lane for Fiora, early game is pretty hard for you, try to force fight level 1 when he has no stacks. Once you get a few levels, it's gonna become very hard. Rengar will probably go Bramble vest, so your healing is a lot weaker. You should also go for Executioner's or Bramble. You can 1v1 him once you get past 3 items, your lategame 1v1 is much better. Your splitpush is about the same.

Make sure to start Dshield, his poke is very strong in the early game. Don't jump him level 1 without stacks, he wins. Make sure to jump him only when his passive is down. Don't take unnecessary Qs form him. Levels 2-5 you can easily all in him with tripleQ, he can't fight back. Be careful around barrels, you can jump them, but if he's fast enough, he can destroy them when you are midair and hit you. Try to destroy his barrels, they are a big source of his damage. Level 6 changes nothing, you still beat him without a problem - however warn your teammates that he has R.
Mid-late game you are better at 1v1 and splitpush, however teamfights depend on the skill of GP (if he's extermely good, he …

Teleport + Flash
Ignite + Flash
You can run both, Ignite counters GPs W healing, but the lane is easy even without it.

Rune setup 1 or 2
Adaptive/AS, adaptive and Armor
Rune setup 1 will give you enough laning power and strong late game
Rune setup 3 will give you strong lane phase and weaker late game
I myself prefer using Rune setup 1, you can't really proc Grasp that much (barrels and his passive) and your all ins are very strong

Dshield+1pot
All damage builds can 1v1 him
I personally would choose Goredrinker or Eclipse

Level 1 don't fight him when his passive or Q are up. Once you get to 4 stacks, you can engage, but only when his passive is down. Levels 2-5 you do the same thing, engage when his passive is down. Be mindful of his barrels, he can explode them with an AA when you jump him. If he is too far from his barrels, make sure to jump them, they give you 10 gold AND they take away a big source of his early game damage. At no point should GP be actually able to kill you. At level 6 warn your teammates that he has R, but continue doing what you were doing.
Mid-late game you should easily 1v1 GP, you splitpush better than he does and teamfight are Rengar sided, unless the GP is extremely good and has perfect barrel combos.

Hard lane for you, Rengar will probably have Dshield and Second wind, so your Q poke is basically worthless. If he goes for a minion or jumps you, try to hit him with your passive into Q. Keep barrels close to you, he can jump to them and his jump is faster than your Q, so you have to hit them manually with your AA. Also keep in mind that he can jump them at 2HP and Q reset to kill it before you can. Your W can cancel his root.

Grasp makes this lane much better. Level 1 fight only when his Q is on cooldown. Level 2-5 you need to play around your doubleW as much as you can. Level 6 you need to be much more cautious around fights, but you can still duel him if you play with your W perfectly. If your jungler helps you and you get fed early, you can snowball very hard.
Mid-late game you don't want to 1v1 him unless you are ahead, your splitpush and teamfights are much better, use those.

Flash + Teleport
You can try going for Ignite instead of TP, but a good Garen will not fight you pre6 and after 6 if you are even, the ignite doesn't change much. You usually can't all in the Garen, so it's better to play slow and go TP and outscale him.

Rune setup 3.
Adaptive/AS, adaptive and Armor
Rune setup 3 allows you to be very healthy during lane, go for extra poke and makes you tankier
You can use rune setup 1 or 2, but I think their laning phase is too weak to be considered. I always run Grasp into Garen, it fits my playstyle too well

Dblade+1pot - if you are confident, you can start Long Sword+3pots
Shieldbow, Sunderer and Goredrinker can 1v1 him late
I personally would choose Goredrinker, because of the components that are very strong for lane

Level 1 take Q, don't fight him unless he uses his own Q. Level 2 take W, you can start jumping in (don't use 4 ferocity). Once he uses his AA,Q on you, instantly doubleW, AA, Q, E and run to the bush. Keep repeating this process for most of the laning phase. After level 6 be much more cautious tho, if you are too low, he can oneshot you with R. If you survive his R, make sure to W heal it.
I prefer rushing Seeker's armguard in this matchup (if my team doesn't have too many AP champions), it gives me a lot more damage on my doubleW (which I use the entire laning phase) and the 45 armor helps out a lot. However, if I am snowballing or I feel like the Garen is very bad with his champion, I ski…
Mid-late game don't fight Garen if you are even or behind. Your splitpush is better and so is your teamfighting, so force fights.

Annoying lane if the Rengar is very good. You can try to fight him level 1 when he goes for minions with AA into Q reset, but be careful around his 4 stack. Levels 2-5 are harder, Rengar has a lot of power that you don't. Wait for level 6, you get a combat ultimate and he doesn't. Rush bramble vest, that makes the lane much harder for the Rengar. Stridebreaker is good mythic into him. If you are ahead, keep pressing him, you are stronger.

Easy lane most of the time. Fighting mini Gnar is very easy, mega Gnar not so much. Don't try to 1v1 his mega form, too much CC and damage. You can almost oneshot his mini form if you play it correctly and he has no E. Your empW can cancel both his W and R.
Mid-late game 1v1s are not that good, he can jump away, slow you with Q and kite you with his W movement speed. Splitpushing is much better for you, teamfights depend on the location, if he lands a big R into big W, he can win the teamfight despite being 0/10.

Teleport + Flash
Ignite + Flash
You can run both, Ignite gives you more kill pressure, but you don't need it.

Rune setup 1
Adaptive/AS, adaptive and armor
Rune setup 1 makes your all ins stronger into his mini form, you want prolonged fights with his mini form and Second wind is good into his ranged AAs
I always use Rune setup 1

Dshield+1pot or Dblade+1pot - if you are confident, you can start Long Sword+3pots, but I wouldn't do that.
Most damage mythics can kill mini Gnar
I personally would choose Goredrinker or Eclipse

Gnar most likely goes Q level 1, so if he throws it and misses, you can engage on him. Levels 2-5 are easy against mini Gnar. If he has Boneplating, break it with either E or your jump (when he throws Q and misses, so he can't proc W on you). Fighting mini Gnar is very easy, he's extremely squishy. If you manage to root him before your jump so he can't E away, you can almost oneshot him. Fighting mega Gnar is hard, I wouldn't suggest doing that. He has low cooldowns and very high damage. Just wait it out and you're good. But if you decide to fight it, your empW can cancel both his R and W.

Mid-late game 1v1 is very hard if you can't oneshot his mini form, because he will just E away and kite you with his QW. His mega form can 1v1 you due to his high CC and damage. You splitpush much much better. Teamfights are better for him if he manages to land a big R, if he screws up, you are better.

Hard for a Mini Gnar, easier for Mega Gnar. Mini is very squishy, Rengar can easily oneshot you with a full combo. Keep your E for a jump away if he tries to go for all in. Try to get yourself to Mega as much as you can, then you can jump him and duel him. If you hit your spells as Mega, you will outdamage him. In late game don't try to 1v1, rather try to force teamfights. You are much more useful than he is, your ult gives you a lot of teamfight power, he is much weaker in teamfights and stronger on sidelane.

Very annoying lane with almost no kill pressure from both sides. I go Grasp for more early game pressure and the extra health. You want to bait out his E - early game cooldown fairly high (16 seconds, 13 if he hits something). Once his E is down, you can be aggressive towards him and either force a solokill or make him lose CS. Play the lane slow, try to keep your health up with your W. Gragas has insane sustain with his passive, trading HP for HP is not worth it, you have to hard win trades.Try to time your W for his EW. Once he gets a few levels and cooldown items, killing him is nearly impossible, he is too tanky and has too much disengage with his E.
Mid-late game 1v1 is nearly impossibl…

Teleport + Flash
Ignite is pointless here, you get almost 0 chances to really kill Gragas, it's a waste of a summoner spell.

Rune setup 3
Adaptive/AS, adaptive and MR
Conqueror feels absolutely useless into Gragas, you can't use it on lane at all, Gragas can disengage too well for you to consider Conqueror
Grasp allows you to heal during lane (and match Gragas healing) and get a lot of bonus HP due to Grasp +5 max HP use

Dshield+1pot or Dblade+1pot
No build is strong for 1v1
I personally would choose either tank, if my team needs one or Goredrinker or Sunderer

Take Grasp, Conqueror is absolutely useless for most of the laning phase.
Level 1 farm your Qs up, if Gragas has Q or W, you can jump him to proc your Grasp and reset with Q. Levels 2-5 it's harder, Gragas has his E which can cancel your AA in your jump. What you want to do is bait it out by jumping on him without using stacks (if he goes for a full combo on you, double W and do your combo), then going back into the bush and zoning him out or forcing a fight. His E has a fairly long cooldown on early ranks (16,15,14 -> 13,12,11 if he hits something), so use that window to do damage. Try to end most of your trades with empW, because Gragas has insane sustain thanks to his passive - you need t…
Mid-late game 1v1 is extremely pointless, you can't ever force a fight on him. You splitpush much better than he does, teamfights depend on what his team comp looks like and how well he plays them.

A very annoying lane for both players. Take Grasp, max E. Be careful in the early game, that is the only point where he can get a kill on you. Make sure to utilize your passive to keep yourself as healthy as you can. This lane is basically no kill lane, you can't kill him through his sustain and he can't kill you through yours. Bramble vest can be useful in this lane if you want more pressure and better 1v1 power, but it's not needed.

Start Dblade, level 1 don't fight her level 1 if she has Ignite+TP. Levels 2-5 try to all in with empQ, use your W on her 4stack Q. If she uses her W, empW and run away, if her W is on cooldown, empQ and continue the fight. Level 6 force her R and disengage, wait for it to run out. You should be stomping this lane, she is very weak early compared to you, so that is good. Mid-late game she'll become stronger and can kill you if you don't burst her fast enough. Try to end the game before she gets to strong.

Teleport + Flash
Ignite + Flash
You can run both, Ignite gives you more kill pressure, but you don't need it.

Rune setup 1
Adaptive/AS, adaptive and MR
Conqueror is the best option into her, you don't need extra sustain and Grasp is not good enough in this lane. Force fights, make use of your Conqueror.

Take Conqueror and Dblade level 1. Stack your Q on minions, force on her with 4 stacks. Levels 2-5 you want to use empQ in bush, jump on her, force her W and then doubleW her 4stack Q -> run into bush. Get your 4 stacks again and all in her, her W should be on cooldown (it has a big CD, you can get back to 4 ferocity before it's up). 2nd fight use your empQ and you should be able to oneshot her. Level 6 be mindful of her R, once she uses it, try to disengage if possible. Wait out her R and then all in her again.
